title: Mapping an independent product coordinatewise
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, and let $A_i$ and $B_i$ be finite sets for each $i\in I$. Choose a probability mass function $p_i$ on each $A_i$ and a function $f_i:A_i\to B_i$ for each coordinate. Mapping each coordinate of the independent product through its corresponding $f_i$ gives the independent product of the distributions obtained by mapping each $p_i$ through $f_i$.
